title: Final Answer 1s
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct expression for the Lamb shift of the 1s level, including the correct coefficients and variables.

title: Final Answer 2p
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly state that the Lamb shift for the 2p level is zero.

title: Use of Delta Function
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly apply the Dirac delta function in the integration process.

title: Wave Function Evaluation
description: Important Criteria - The student must correctly evaluate the wave functions at the origin for both 1s and 2p levels.

title: Correct Constants
description: Optional Criteria - The student should use the correct fundamental constants in their final expressions.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid sign mistakes in their calculations, particularly when applying the Laplacian operator.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as 4π, are included in their final answers.
